versions.changelog:
- Internal updates to scripts/bring-cli.js; no changes to user-facing documentation or commands.
- No changes to workflow, prerequisites, or usage instructions.

- Migrated CLI interface: commands now use `scripts/bring-cli.js` with explicit NODE_PATH for global install.
- Added new `smartadd` command for catalog-aware item insertion with icon support.
- List language detection improved with `detectlang`, `setlang`, and `getlang` commands.
- Authentication tokens are now cached for 7 days; new `renew` command to force re-login.
- Documentation rewritten: concise command reference, clarified workflows, emphasized exact item name matching (case-sensitive).
- Dropped skill-card.md in favor of standardized _meta.json for metadata.

Initial release: Manage Bring! shopping lists with support for multiple languages. Features: view all lists, find lists by name, add/remove items, set default list, configure list languages (Italian, Spanish, English, German, French). Perfect for multilingual families.
